description: This file defines the Weight class within the Opencart system, responsible for managing weight units, conversions, and formatting based on database-driven weight classes.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: A class to handle weight conversions, formatting, and retrieval of weight units based on database entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Weight object, loading weight class data from the database based on the current language ID.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a weight value from one weight class to another.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a weight value into a string with units, respecting local formatting preferences.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the measurement unit for a specific weight class ID.
